name: Lesser Spell Synthesis (Mythic)
body:
You can concentrate on different spell traditions with astonishing ease.

Prerequisite(s): Lesser Spell Synthesis, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use lesser spell synthesis. This stacks with additional uses of lesser spell synthesis per day gained through the non-mythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Lesser Spell Synthesis, this feat may be selected only once.
